title: CustomField

DefinitionId.description: Product: ALL Description: Unique identifier of the CustomFieldDefinition that corresponds to this CustomField. DefinitionId is required for every CustomField.

Name.description: Product: ALL Description: Name of the custom field.

Type.description: Product: ALL Description: Data type of custom field.[br /]

StringValue.description: Product: ALL Description: The value for a StringType custom field.

BooleanValue.description: Product: ALL Description: The value for a BooleanType custom field.

DateValue.description: Product: ALL Description: The value for a DateType custom field.

NumberValue.description: Product: ALL Description: The value for a NumberType custom field.

description: Product: ALL Description: Custom field that can be added to an entity. This type is not extended from IntuitEntity as CustomField can not be manipulated as independent entity and will always be considered in association with another top level Intuit entity.
